title: Oven Roasted Argentinian Lamb Gratin
description: A floral, crisp lamb mince gratin inspired by monsoon flavors, finished with a burst of bonito shavings and served from a raclette grill.
instructions: Preheat your raclette grill to medium-high heat.
In a bowl mix the lamb mince, chopped onion, minced garlic, sliced bell pepper, tomato paste, soy sauce, salt, pepper and lemon zest until well combined.
Transfer the mixture into a shallow baking dish and spread evenly.
Drizzle olive oil over the top and sprinkle bonito shavings evenly.
Place the dish on the raclette grill and roast for 30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the top is golden.
Remove the gratin from the grill, let it rest for five minutes.
Serve hot, garnishing with extra bonito shavings if desired.
